d: Watch this video as Firstpost explains how US President Donald Trump has triggered a diplomatic rift after making derogatory comments about African nations during a political rally in Perry, Georgia. Targeting US Senator Jon Ossoff over immigration legislation, Trump revived harsh rhetoric, calling several nations 'terror-infested'. The remarks prompted immediate backlash from Libya, where the Foreign Ministry summoned the US Chargé d’Affaires to lodge an official protest, stating the comments undermined the dignity of the Libyan people.
